# agentic-design

Accessible design tokens and UI primitives for calm, minimal apps.

Keywords: design-system,tokens,ui,accessibility,wcag,react,components,minimal,dark-mode.

- CSS: import "agentic-design/styles.css", then use var(--ad-color-bg) and friends.
- Library: import { themes, scale } from "agentic-design/tokens". React parts: import { Button, ShareDialog, PresenceChip } from "agentic-design/react".
- CLI: agentic-design tokens --format json.
- MCP: run agentic-design mcp, then call get_tokens or check_contrast.
- HTTP: GET /api/v1/tokens.

## App chrome (React, agentic-design/react)

Use these for the frame of any editor. They need only the stylesheet. Each example in the README is a whole module.

- AppShell: <AppShell brand="Docs" sidebar={<SidebarNav label="Main" items={[{ href: "/", label: "Home", current: true }]} />} title={<DocumentTitle value={t} onRename={setT} />} topbar={<AgentBadge compact name="Claude" actingFor="Ada Lovelace" />} panel={<Comments />} panelLabel="Comments">{children}</AppShell>
- Toolbar: <Toolbar label="Tools"><ToolbarGroup label="Text style"><ToolbarButton label="Bold" icon={<b>B</b>} pressed={bold} onClick={toggle} /></ToolbarGroup><ToolbarOverflow items={[{ label: "Word count", onSelect }]} /></Toolbar>
- DocumentTitle: <DocumentTitle value={title} onRename={setTitle} />. Enter, Space, or F2 renames. Escape cancels. Put it in the top bar, not in a dialog.
- ShareDialog: <ShareDialog trigger={<Button>Share</Button>} resourceName="Plan" people={people} onInvite onChangeRole onRemove link={link} onChangeLink snapshot={{ onCreate }} onCopy={copy} />. It is a view with no network.
- FileList: <FileList label="Files" view="table" items={items} loading={loading} />. Items have id, name, href, owner (a presence entry), modified. view is "table" or "grid". Add sort and onSortChange to control the sort.
- AgentBadge: <AgentBadge name="Claude" actingFor="Ada Lovelace" />. Add compact for an avatar only. Show it on everything an agent made.

Rules: use tokens only, never a hex value. Show an agent as an agent. Pass a peer display name through usableName.
